summary: STRATEX iteration 4 (multi-facet topology engine + Advanced Diagnostics dashboard). FULL PASS on backend (10/10 new topology tests + 18/18 regression = 28/28) and frontend (all critical flows on public preview URL). Backend verified: POST /api/projects with each preset (cross_hip, hip, gable, l_shape, dutch_gable) returns roof_telemetry with facets[] (>=4 for cross_hip; each has id/vertices/normal/area_planar_sf/area_true_sf/pitch/color_tag), edges[] (each with a/b/length_ft/classification in {ridge,valley,hip,eave,rake}), totals (total_sf, squares, ridges_lf, valleys_lf, hips_lf, eaves_lf, rakes_lf), rtk_precision_cm, style. Math validated: cross_hip has hips_lf>0 and eaves_lf>0; squares == round(total_sf/100, 2); sum(facet.area_true_sf) == totals.total_sf; sec(theta) correction visible (area_true_sf > area_planar_sf on sloped facets). POST /scan returns >=4 facet-localised anomalies; every anomaly has facet_id (referencing a real facet), area_affected_sf>0, diagnosis, severity in {CRITICAL,HIGH,MED,LOW}, confidence in [0,1], thermal_delta, lat/lon, centroid[3], id matching ^AD-KY041-\d{3}$. Existing /pricing and /report.pdf still produce valid output with new telemetry shape. Frontend verified end-to-end: Landing page renders RoofModel3D canvas with zero console errors; /mission/new Step 2 renders all 5 roof-style options (scope-roof-style-{cross_hip,hip,gable,l_shape,dutch_gable}), cross_hip default-active, click on gable switches active state; Mission Dashboard at /mission/eeb8191f-... renders 3-column Advanced Diagnostics layout: Quant rail (qe-squares=28.95, qe-valleys=28.77 LF, qe-hips=191.53 LF, qe-eaves=280.54 LF, qe-rtk=1.66 cm, qe-style=cross_hip), centre 3D model with multi-facet wireframe + colored facets + anomaly polygons + AD-KY041-XXX callout labels, right rail Forensic Overlay (diagnosis/location/area affected/confidence%/thermal Δ + thermal-heatmap canvas) + AnomalySelector with 6 entries and severity LEDs. Clicking 2nd anomaly updates Forensic Overlay AND highlights the corresponding polygon in gold (visible in screenshot). PDF download button present. Zero console errors on landing, /mission/new, /mission/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 775 lines — still close to the 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting pricing engine + PDF builder + AI narratives into separate modules (e.g. pricing.py, pdf_builder.py, agents.py).

roof_topology.preset_dutch_gable currently returns the same shape as a hip box (no actual gablet at the eave-end). Functional but the 'dutch_gable' label is somewhat aspirational — consider adding a true gablet sub-facet at one or both ridge ends so the topology visually differs from preset_hip.

RoofModel3D.jsx anomaly polygon highlight uses gold (#FFD700) for the SELECTED anomaly and plasma-orange for the active callout label — works but the contrast between unselected anomaly polygons (orange #FF8A60) and selected (gold) could be sharpened. Minor visual nit.

/launch endpoint is still synchronous on Claude generation (~90-150s). 'Streaming launch progress' from the original goal still not implemented — pre-existing carry-over from iter 3, not a regression.

preset_cross_hip valley edges are placed at fixed (-2*scale, 0, 4*scale)→(10*scale, 6*scale, 6*scale) etc. — these are visually plausible but not geometrically derived from the two hip-box intersections. The classification engine in the docstring (dihedral-angle test) is not actually run here; for the demo this is acceptable but worth noting for future iteration.
